# Logos Module Atlas

> AI-readable registry of every Logos module available in Logos Basecamp 0.3.1 (latest release): 6 bundled in the app, 46 installable from its default catalog. Each module has a card, its canonical LIDL contract, and its annotated interface source, all pinned to the exact source commit that was released.

Start with AGENTS.md for how to use this repo. registry.json is the machine-readable form of everything below.

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corpetty/logos-module-atlas/main/AGENTS.md): how an AI agent should navigate this registry
- [registry.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corpetty/logos-module-atlas/main/registry.json): every module — versions, deps, source commit, API summary
- [Calling official modules](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corpetty/logos-module-atlas/main/guides/calling-official-modules.md): depend on and call a module from C++, Rust, Nim or QML
- [Compatibility](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corpetty/logos-module-atlas/main/guides/compatibility.md): SDK/builder generations and variants that must match
- [Key custody across chains](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corpetty/logos-module-atlas/main/stacks/key-custody.md): who holds keys and how signing is approved, per chain
- [Gaps](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corpetty/logos-module-atlas/main/gaps.md): roadmap items not shipped in 0.3.1

## Stacks

- [EVM wallet](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corpetty/logos-module-atlas/main/stacks/evm-wallet.md): Ethereum/EVM accounts, signing, fees, RPC, tokens, swaps — one keystore, one tx sender, human approval in a signer UI.
- [Monero wallet](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corpetty/logos-module-atlas/main/stacks/monero-wallet.md): wallet2 (monero_c) in-process, a backend coordinator, remote or in-process monerod.
- [Blockchain & LEZ](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corpetty/logos-module-atlas/main/stacks/blockchain-lez.md): Logos blockchain node, the Logos Execution Zone (LEZ) client/wallet, indexer, explorer and AMM.
- [Messaging](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corpetty/logos-module-atlas/main/stacks/messaging.md): Delivery (Waku-style) node, e2e chat, libp2p, and RLN membership/proofs.
- [Storage](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corpetty/logos-module-atlas/main/stacks/storage.md): Logos Storage node: upload, download, manifests.
- [Platform](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corpetty/logos-module-atlas/main/stacks/platform.md): What Basecamp ships itself: package manager & downloader, capability (permissions), module lifecycle state, metrics, accounts.

## Modules: Blockchain & LEZ

- [amm_module](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corpetty/logos-module-atlas/main/modules/amm_module/README.md): core 0.1.0 — Core module for the Logos DEX (AMM) — on-chain pool resolution, swaps, and liquidity.
- [amm_ui](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corpetty/logos-module-atlas/main/modules/amm_ui/README.md): ui_qml 0.1.0 — Trade tokens and provide liquidity on the Logos DEX.
- [blockchain_module](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corpetty/logos-module-atlas/main/modules/blockchain_module/README.md): core 0.3.0 — Logos blockchain node for logos-core
  - contract: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corpetty/logos-module-atlas/main/modules/blockchain_module/blockchain_module.lidl
- [blockchain_ui](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corpetty/logos-module-atlas/main/modules/blockchain_ui/README.md): ui_qml 0.3.1 — Blockchain UI module for the Logos application
- [lez_core](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corpetty/logos-module-atlas/main/modules/lez_core/README.md): core 0.5.0 — Logos Execution Zone Core Module for Logos Core
  - contract: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corpetty/logos-module-atlas/main/modules/lez_core/lez_core.lidl
- [lez_explorer_ui](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corpetty/logos-module-atlas/main/modules/lez_explorer_ui/README.md): ui_qml 1.2.0 — Logos Execution Zone Block Explorer
- [lez_indexer_module](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corpetty/logos-module-atlas/main/modules/lez_indexer_module/README.md): core 1.2.0 — Logos Execution Zone Indexer Module for Logos Core
  - contract: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corpetty/logos-module-atlas/main/modules/lez_indexer_module/lez_indexer_module.lidl
- [lez_wallet_ui](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corpetty/logos-module-atlas/main/modules/lez_wallet_ui/README.md): ui_qml 1.2.0 — Execution Zone Wallet UI module for the Logos application
- [logos_execution_zone](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corpetty/logos-module-atlas/main/modules/logos_execution_zone/README.md): core 1.0.0 — Logos Execution Zone Module for Logos Core
  - contract: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corpetty/logos-module-atlas/main/modules/logos_execution_zone/logos_execution_zone.lidl

## Modules: EVM wallet

- [eth_rpc_module](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corpetty/logos-module-atlas/main/modules/eth_rpc_module/README.md): core 0.1.0 — Proxyable, fail-closed Ethereum JSON-RPC client. Per-chain config (endpoint + proxy); RPC calls keyed by chainId. socks5h/Tor-ready.
  - contract: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corpetty/logos-module-atlas/main/modules/eth_rpc_module/eth_rpc_module.lidl
- [eth_rpc_ui](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corpetty/logos-module-atlas/main/modules/eth_rpc_ui/README.md): ui_qml 0.1.0 — Device-wide JSON-RPC endpoints and light-client verified routing, shared by every Logos wallet on this device.
- [eth_wallet_backend](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corpetty/logos-module-atlas/main/modules/eth_wallet_backend/README.md): core 0.1.0 — EVM wallet composer over reusable chain, asset, token, account, fee, and transaction-sender modules, with multi-chain balances and activity.
  - contract: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corpetty/logos-module-atlas/main/modules/eth_wallet_backend/eth_wallet_backend.lidl
- [eth_wallet_ui](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corpetty/logos-module-atlas/main/modules/eth_wallet_ui/README.md): ui_qml 0.1.0 — View EVM assets and activity across enabled networks, and send on an explicitly selected chain. Holds no key material.
- [evm_assets_module](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corpetty/logos-module-atlas/main/modules/evm_assets_module/README.md): core 0.1.0 — Reusable native and ERC-20 asset rows, balances, transfer building, and transaction-history decoration.
  - contract: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corpetty/logos-module-atlas/main/modules/evm_assets_module/evm_assets_module.lidl
- [evm_keystore_cli](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corpetty/logos-module-atlas/main/modules/evm_keystore_cli/README.md): core 0.1.0 — Headless custodian for keystore_module: creates, imports, exports and deletes accounts over `logosctl call`. Every other headless surface only reads which accounts exist.
  - contract: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corpetty/logos-module-atlas/main/modules/evm_keystore_cli/evm_keystore_cli.lidl
- [evm_keystore_ui](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corpetty/logos-module-atlas/main/modules/evm_keystore_ui/README.md): ui_qml 0.1.0 — The one place accounts are created, imported, exported and deleted. Every other surface only reads which accounts exist.
- [evm_signer_cli](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corpetty/logos-module-atlas/main/modules/evm_signer_cli/README.md): core 0.1.0 — Headless approver for keystore_module: shows what a module asked to sign, in the keystore's own words, over `logosctl watch`, and takes the decision over `logosctl call`.
  - contract: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corpetty/logos-module-atlas/main/modules/evm_signer_cli/evm_signer_cli.lidl
- [evm_signer_ui](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corpetty/logos-module-atlas/main/modules/evm_signer_ui/README.md): ui_qml 0.1.0 — The signing approval surface: shows what a module asked to sign, in the keystore's own words, and takes the vault password.
- [fee_module](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corpetty/logos-module-atlas/main/modules/fee_module/README.md): core 0.1.0 — EIP-1559 fee suggestion for EVM chains: slow/normal/fast tiers derived from eth_feeHistory, with custom overrides.
  - contract: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corpetty/logos-module-atlas/main/modules/fee_module/fee_module.lidl
- [keystore_module](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corpetty/logos-module-atlas/main/modules/keystore_module/README.md): core 0.1.0 — Keystore: scrypt vaults, BIP39/BIP32 HD derivation, secp256k1 signing. No network; private keys never leave the module.
  - contract: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corpetty/logos-module-atlas/main/modules/keystore_module/keystore_module.lidl
- [token_list_module](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corpetty/logos-module-atlas/main/modules/token_list_module/README.md): core 0.1.0 — Reusable EVM token catalogue, enabled snapshots, pinned assets and paged picker. Proxyable, fail-closed.
  - contract: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corpetty/logos-module-atlas/main/modules/token_list_module/token_list_module.lidl
- [token_list_ui](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corpetty/logos-module-atlas/main/modules/token_list_ui/README.md): ui_qml 0.1.0 — Device-wide token catalogue and enabled set: built-in defaults, extra list URLs, custom tokens, and the ERC-20s shared by every Logos wallet on this device.
- [tx_sender_module](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corpetty/logos-module-atlas/main/modules/tx_sender_module/README.md): core 0.1.0 — The one EVM transaction sender on the device: one nonce ledger, call bundles approved as one decision in the keystore, ordered broadcast, and a write-ahead local history. Holds no key material and chooses no chain.
  - contract: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corpetty/logos-module-atlas/main/modules/tx_sender_module/tx_sender_module.lidl
- [uniswap_backend](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corpetty/logos-module-atlas/main/modules/uniswap_backend/README.md): core 0.1.0 — The Uniswap app's backend: quotes, swaps and swap history composed from reusable EVM chain, token, asset, account, fee, quote and sender modules. Holds no key material.
  - contract: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corpetty/logos-module-atlas/main/modules/uniswap_backend/uniswap_backend.lidl
- [uniswap_module](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corpetty/logos-module-atlas/main/modules/uniswap_module/README.md): core 0.1.0 — Uniswap price oracle + swap router: V2/V3/V4 token prices (best-rate, Multicall3-batched) and V2/V3 swap building. Multi-chain, configurable.
  - contract: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corpetty/logos-module-atlas/main/modules/uniswap_module/uniswap_module.lidl
- [uniswap_ui](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corpetty/logos-module-atlas/main/modules/uniswap_ui/README.md): ui_qml 0.1.0 — Swap EVM assets on Uniswap. A view over uniswap_backend, which composes the reusable EVM modules.
- [verified_proxy_module](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corpetty/logos-module-atlas/main/modules/verified_proxy_module/README.md): core 0.1.3 — Light-client-verified Ethereum JSON-RPC, wrapping nimbus libverifproxy
  - contract: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corpetty/logos-module-atlas/main/modules/verified_proxy_module/verified_proxy_module.lidl
- [verified_proxy_ui](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corpetty/logos-module-atlas/main/modules/verified_proxy_ui/README.md): ui_qml 0.1.0 — Configure and operate the light-client-verified Ethereum proxy

## Modules: Messaging

- [chat_module](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corpetty/logos-module-atlas/main/modules/chat_module/README.md): core 0.3.0 — Chat module for Logos
  - contract: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corpetty/logos-module-atlas/main/modules/chat_module/chat_module.lidl
- [chat_ui](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corpetty/logos-module-atlas/main/modules/chat_ui/README.md): ui_qml 0.3.0 — Chat App for Logos - Private messaging interface
- [delivery_demo](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corpetty/logos-module-atlas/main/modules/delivery_demo/README.md): ui_qml 0.3.0 — Educational UI demo for logos-delivery-module: subscribe to content topics, send and receive messages, see which delivery_module API calls back each interaction.
- [delivery_module](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corpetty/logos-module-atlas/main/modules/delivery_module/README.md): core 0.3.0 — Logos Delivery Module - High-level message-delivery API
  - contract: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corpetty/logos-module-atlas/main/modules/delivery_module/delivery_module.lidl
- [liblogos_lez_rln_module](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corpetty/logos-module-atlas/main/modules/liblogos_lez_rln_module/README.md): core 4.2.1 — RLN registry provider (LEZ chain reads + registration/funding txs)
  - contract: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corpetty/logos-module-atlas/main/modules/liblogos_lez_rln_module/liblogos_lez_rln_module.lidl
- [liblogos_rln_module](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corpetty/logos-module-atlas/main/modules/liblogos_rln_module/README.md): core 0.10.0 — Registry-agnostic RLN membership management (RLN-MEMBERSHIP-MANAGEMENT)
  - contract: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corpetty/logos-module-atlas/main/modules/liblogos_rln_module/liblogos_rln_module.lidl
- [libp2p_module](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corpetty/logos-module-atlas/main/modules/libp2p_module/README.md): core 1.1.0 — Libp2p network protocol module for Logos
  - contract: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corpetty/logos-module-atlas/main/modules/libp2p_module/libp2p_module.lidl

## Modules: Monero wallet

- [monero_node_module](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corpetty/logos-module-atlas/main/modules/monero_node_module/README.md): core 0.1.0 — Proxyable, fail-closed monerod JSON-RPC client. Per-network config (endpoint + proxy); socks5h/Tor-ready. Never runs a node itself; local mode dials the one monerod_module runs.
  - contract: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corpetty/logos-module-atlas/main/modules/monero_node_module/monero_node_module.lidl
- [monero_wallet_backend](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corpetty/logos-module-atlas/main/modules/monero_wallet_backend/README.md): core 0.1.0 — Monero wallet coordinator: wallet registry, sync poller, balances and history, send orchestration (build → review → broadcast). Holds no key material.
  - contract: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corpetty/logos-module-atlas/main/modules/monero_wallet_backend/monero_wallet_backend.lidl
- [monero_wallet_cli](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corpetty/logos-module-atlas/main/modules/monero_wallet_cli/README.md): core 0.1.0 — Headless Monero wallet for monero_wallet_backend: open or create a wallet, read the balance and addresses, build a transfer, review it and broadcast or withdraw it, all over `logosctl call`. Holds the custodian and approver roles, so a bare CLI (the host anchor) can do none of it.
  - contract: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corpetty/logos-module-atlas/main/modules/monero_wallet_cli/monero_wallet_cli.lidl
- [monero_wallet_core_module](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corpetty/logos-module-atlas/main/modules/monero_wallet_core_module/README.md): core 0.1.0 — In-process Monero wallet engine: wraps monero_c (wallet2 C ABI, LGPL-3.0, dynamically linked, built from source). Keys and the wallet password never leave this module.
  - contract: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corpetty/logos-module-atlas/main/modules/monero_wallet_core_module/monero_wallet_core_module.lidl
- [monero_wallet_ui](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corpetty/logos-module-atlas/main/modules/monero_wallet_ui/README.md): ui_qml 0.1.0 — The Monero wallet: balances, a reviewed send, receive addresses with a QR, activity, and the wallet management (create, restore, open, close, change password, show seed) every Monero wallet keeps in the same app. The password crosses as a SLOT argument only, never as a property.
- [monerod_module](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corpetty/logos-module-atlas/main/modules/monerod_module/README.md): core 0.1.0 — Runs a Monero node in-process: per-network config, start, stop, status and log tail.
  - contract: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corpetty/logos-module-atlas/main/modules/monerod_module/monerod_module.lidl
- [monerod_ui](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corpetty/logos-module-atlas/main/modules/monerod_ui/README.md): ui_qml 0.1.0 — Run and manage a local Monero node: sync progress, peers, settings and the node log.

## Modules: Platform

- [accounts_ui](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corpetty/logos-module-atlas/main/modules/accounts_ui/README.md): ui_qml 0.3.0 — Create and manage Logos accounts and their keys.
- [capability_module](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corpetty/logos-module-atlas/main/modules/capability_module/README.md): core 1.0.0 — Coordinates permissions between modules
  - contract: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corpetty/logos-module-atlas/main/modules/capability_module/capability_module.lidl
- [modules_state](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corpetty/logos-module-atlas/main/modules/modules_state/README.md): core 0.1.0 — Read-only registry of module lifecycle state
  - contract: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corpetty/logos-module-atlas/main/modules/modules_state/modules_state.lidl
- [openmetrics](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corpetty/logos-module-atlas/main/modules/openmetrics/README.md): core 0.1.1 — Serves an OpenMetrics /metrics endpoint by scraping modules that implement collectMetrics()
  - contract: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corpetty/logos-module-atlas/main/modules/openmetrics/openmetrics.lidl
- [package_downloader](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corpetty/logos-module-atlas/main/modules/package_downloader/README.md): core 1.0.0 — Online package catalog and download service
  - contract: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corpetty/logos-module-atlas/main/modules/package_downloader/package_downloader.lidl
- [package_manager](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corpetty/logos-module-atlas/main/modules/package_manager/README.md): core 1.0.0 — Plugin manager for the Logos system
  - contract: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corpetty/logos-module-atlas/main/modules/package_manager/package_manager.lidl
- [package_manager_ui](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corpetty/logos-module-atlas/main/modules/package_manager_ui/README.md): ui_qml 1.0.0 — Package Manager UI plugin for managing plugins and packages

## Modules: Storage

- [storage_module](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corpetty/logos-module-atlas/main/modules/storage_module/README.md): core 3.0.0 — Storage module
  - contract: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corpetty/logos-module-atlas/main/modules/storage_module/storage_module.lidl
- [storage_ui](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corpetty/logos-module-atlas/main/modules/storage_ui/README.md): ui_qml 3.0.0 — Storage interface for the Logos application
